title: Hearty Malty Ukrainian Soya Pudding
description: A malty, pillowy, festive Ukrainian dish featuring soya milk, lamination-puff, and ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients, served in a ramekin.
instructions: Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out small squares of pastry, about 3 inches per side.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soya milk, malt syrup, maple syrup, vanilla extract, and sea salt.
Spoon a small amount of the soya milk mixture onto one half of each pastry square, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Fold the other half of the pastry square over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Place the filled pastry squares in a ramekin, leaving about 1 inch of space between each square.
Bake the pudding for 25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Remove the pudding from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
